notes.title: The release date of Biped 2!
notes.notes:
Greetings, adventurers!



Today we have some great news for you: the full version of Biped 2 will be released on November 5, 2025! 

A new journey is just around the corner — get ready for new locations, game mechanics, and brand new features as an even more convenient co-op system and the ability to customize your character.

notes.title: Biped 2 Demo Update is Live!
notes.notes:
Hello, Bipeds!



We are extremely excited to present a new demo update! We’ve got lots of feedback and made awesome changes to make Biped 2 an even better game for everyone. 



So, what’s new? 

Peer-to-peer online connection — no more region selections or any other shenanigans. Now, coop mode works through the P2P connection system, which should drastically improve ping. connection quality and streamline the experience;

Easy and Hard mode selection — we’ve had lots of feedback about the puzzle difficulty and a need for a more relaxed experience, akin to the first game. We’ve added a new difficulty setting, so now you are in full control of your gameplay. Challenge lovers can tackle the hard mode, and if you are here just for the vibes with your friends, the easy mode is a perfect choice for you.

Brand new PVP mode — for the first time ever, Biped will have a 2 vs 2 PVP mode. Race your friends through the levels and see who is the fastest Biped! In the Demo, you can have a taste of one level in this new mode. 

Please share your feedback with us! It is a huge help for us, and we want to hear about your new experience with P2P connection, easy mode, and the PVP challenge. And don’t forget to wishlist and follow Biped 2 on Steam to be first to hear all the exciting news.



Until next time, adventurers!

notes.title: A new patch for Biped 2 Demo is here!
notes.notes:
Hello, adventurers!

A patch for Biped 2 Demo is out now on Steam - don't forget to update your game for the changes to take effect. Here's a list of what awaits you in the new version:


 Changes to the cooperative mode interface - the region selection window will now appear at the very beginning of the game session
 Improved controller input in the main menu as well as in the game itself
 General bug fixes


We continue to improve the game further - let us know what you think about the new cooperative mode interface and other changes!

Until next time, adventurers!

notes.title: Biped 2 DEMO Update is live now
notes.notes:
Hey adventurers.

We are happy to announce that the Biped 2 DEMO update is live now on Steam. Try it alone or with one or three friends in Local or Online COOP. 

An update includes the following changes:

Updates:
A brand-new UI, way more appealing and clear
You will find new but currently hidden changes that will be available in the final game

Fixes:
Camera and view angle improvements
Balancing on the levels
A few minor bugs were fixed
Improved optimization and stability
Fixed an issue with the exit screen.

Please share your thoughts via the survey link inside the game or use Steam and Discord. And invite your friends - the DEMO is free!

See you there!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3453220/Biped_2_Demo
